nodes.label: LangGraph Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: One shared graph (parse -> context_build -> 5 parallel analysts -> debate -> judge -> decide) serves the live API, schedulers, and retrigger paths; only the run_id prefix differs, keeping behavior identical across entry points.

nodes.label: RuleEvaluator (rules.json)
nodes.rationale: Scoring, signals, and override rules are deliberately LLM-free and deterministic; the LLM only adds narrative, so signal outcomes are auditable and reproducible. Rules with missing context inputs are marked skipped rather than failing the run.

nodes.label: ContextBuilder
nodes.rationale: Aggregates OHLC, fundamentals, and news/sentiment from providers (Upstox, Yahoo, screener.in, GDELT) into one structured dict; provider failures or rate limits leave fields absent, which downstream surfaces as 'rules skipped' rather than an LLM failure.

nodes.label: DecisionAgent (Deterministic Decision Layer)
nodes.rationale: Position sizing bands, stop/target, requires_human_review, and low-data-coverage caps use no LLM at all, so any logic that 'moves money' stays auditable.

nodes.label: Multi-Provider LLM Resolution (instructor + LiteLLM)
nodes.rationale: instructor over litellm lets any one of OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Mistral/Groq keys power all chat steps via LLM_PROVIDER_PRIORITY; with no key configured, narrators fall back to templates so the deterministic pipeline still runs without external LLM calls.

nodes.label: Hybrid RAG (Qdrant + BM25)
nodes.rationale: Optional retrieval layer that enriches judge context only when Qdrant is configured; the system degrades gracefully without it.

nodes.label: Daily Run Idempotency Key
nodes.rationale: Ticker + market + UTC calendar day maps to a fixed 16-char hex run_id; a duplicate POST returns the existing run (idempotent_hit=True) instead of starting a second graph, preventing wasted tokens and conflicting runs.

nodes.label: Event Bus (Redis or In-Memory)
nodes.rationale: RunManager streams lifecycle events over Redis when configured, else in-memory, so SSE progress works in both local and production setups.

nodes.label: Schedulers (Intraday / Daily / RetriggerSubscriber)
nodes.rationale: IntradayScheduler fires every 5 minutes during NSE hours, DailyScheduler once per business day at 10:00 IST, and RetriggerSubscriber reacts to Redis retrigger:* events (e.g. Upstox WS thresholds) with cooldowns; all reuse the same orchestrator graph with distinct run_id prefixes.

nodes.label: Deploy Split: API on Render, UI on Vercel
nodes.rationale: The FastAPI agent needs long-running POSTs, long SSE streams, background schedulers, and Redis-backed checkpoints, which Vercel serverless cannot host (timeouts, cold starts, no long-lived process); so the API runs on a container/VM host via the Render Blueprint while only the Next.js UI goes to Vercel.
nodes.norm_label: deploy split: api on render, ui on vercel

nodes.label: Dark-Mode Design Token System
nodes.rationale: Dark mode only on #0a0c0f with brand accents --buy #00e5a0, --sell #ff4d6d, --neutral #f5a623, --gold #c9a84c; the neutral token's Tailwind utility was renamed to warn to avoid clashing with Tailwind's built-in neutral palette. Typography: Playfair Display (display), IBM Plex Sans (body), IBM Plex Mono (numbers/tickers).

nodes.label: Scenario Regression Set
nodes.rationale: 15 frozen hand-labeled (context, expected_signal) JSON pairs run through the full pipeline in CI; offline and LLM-free so CI is free and reproducible, and any rule/prompt/threshold change that drifts a labeled signal fails the build immediately with a pointed diagnostic. Covers all five signal classes, public-domain override examples (OVR-O1 fraud, OVR-O2 guidance withdrawal, OVR-O3 dividend cut), and a partial-data graceful-degradation case.

nodes.label: PortfolioSimulator
nodes.rationale: Simulates stops, targets, and multi-ticker positions; conservatively assumes the stop hit first when a single bar touches both stop and target, and does not model slippage or partial fills.

nodes.label: HistoricalContextBuilder
nodes.rationale: Synthesises per-day context from cached OHLC only (indicators, relative strength, VIX, beta); fields not derivable from price are left absent because the rule evaluator already skips missing-data rules and treats them as neutral 50, so backtests degrade gracefully on incomplete history. Extension point for historical fundamentals/FRED macro providers.

nodes.label: NoopBuilder
nodes.rationale: Replaces ContextBuilder during backtests so no live API calls happen inside the loop; context is injected via arun(..., context_overrides=...).

nodes.label: Scenario Factory (_factory.py)
nodes.rationale: Keeps one well-tested baseline context dict and expresses each scenario as baseline + a few overrides, because typo'd field names silently skip rules; this types field names once, keeps diffs minimal, and makes mass-adding scenarios (~10 lines each) cheap for scaling to 50-100.

nodes.label: Pillar Analyst Base Prompt
nodes.rationale: The analyst LLM is restricted to narrative and citation extraction: it must not invent scores or propose actions, may only cite rule ids present in the rule outcomes, and must self-rate confidence by the ratio of evaluated to skipped rules.

nodes.label: Bull Agent Debate Prompt
nodes.rationale: Hard 200-word thesis limit, must quote pillar scores numerically, must not decide or propose price targets/sizes, and must lower confidence rather than fabricate strength when evidence is thin.

nodes.label: Bear Agent Debate Prompt
nodes.rationale: Mirror of the bull prompt for the short/avoid case: 200-word limit, numeric pillar-score citations, no short-sale levels or sizes, and explicit instruction not to fabricate weakness.

nodes.label: Strategy Judge Prompt
nodes.rationale: The judge LLM explicitly does NOT decide: signal and composite score are already deterministic; it writes a neutral 4-7 sentence synthesis acknowledging both debate cases, must not contradict the signal, and must lead with active overrides because they dominate.

nodes.label: Render Blueprint (alpha-api)
nodes.rationale: Deploys apps/api as a Python web service from the repo root (pip install . so packages/* resolve), uvicorn with 1 worker, /health health checks; singapore region for lower latency to India, and README recommends the starter plan in production so SSE and schedulers are not killed by free-tier sleep.

nodes.label: Deterministic-Score / LLM-Narrative Separation
nodes.rationale: Core design principle of the system: every score, signal, override, and money-moving decision is computed deterministically by the rule engine and decision layer, while LLMs are confined to narrative, debate framing, and synthesis. This keeps outcomes auditable, reproducible, testable offline without API keys, and robust when no LLM key is configured (templated fallbacks).
